Name: DE-ProjectsPlannedTime
Statement:
select  cli.Oid as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        prj.Oid as ProjectId,
        prj.Number + ' - ' + prj.Name as Project,
        prj.Number as ProjectNumber,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        cls.Oid as ClassificationId,
        cls.Name as Classification,
        nat.Oid as NatureId,
        nat.Name as Nature,
        est.Oid as EstimateId,
        est.Name as Estimate,
        est.Number as EstimateNumber,
        dep.Oid as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        phd.UserTypologyGroup as ProjectPlannedUserTypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as ProjectPlannedUserTypologyGroup,
        phd.[User] as ProjectPlannedUserId,
        usr.Name as ProjectPlannedUser,
        eid.Oid as EstimateItemDetailId,
        (phd.ContractedMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours as ProjectPlannedContractedTime,
        (AdjustmentMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours as ProjectPlannedTime,
        (AdjustmentMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours * pnh.SellRate as ProjectPlannedIncome,
        phd.Date as Month,
        pnh.SellRate as ActualSellRate,
        eid.TableRateSell as ContractedSellRate,
        eid.TableRate as RateCardSellRate,
        pnh.Comments,
        pnh.Description
from    Project prj
            join CommercialClient cli on cli.Oid = prj.Client
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = prj.Product
            join ProjectClassification cls on cls.Oid = prj.Classification 
            join ProjectNature nat on nat.Oid = prj.ProjectNature
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = prj.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            join PlannedHoursDeliverableTotal pnh on pnh.Project = prj.Oid
            join PlannedHoursDeliverableAdjustment phd on prj.Oid = phd.Project and pnh.UserTypologyGroup = phd.UserTypologyGroup and pnh.[User] = phd.[User]
            join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = phd.UserTypologyGroup
            join [User] usr on usr.Oid = pnh.[User]
            join EstimateItemDetail eid on eid.Oid = phd.EstimateItemDetail and eid.Oid = pnh.EstimateItemDetail
            join EstimateItem eit on eit.Oid = eid.EstimateItem
            join Estimate est on est.Oid = eit.Estimate
            join Department dep on dep.Oid = eid.Department
            join Division div on div.Oid = dep.Division
            join Company com on com.Oid = div.Company
where   pnh.GCRecord is null and
        phd.GCRecord is null and
        exists 
        (
            select  1
            from    Estimate est, WorkflowState ewfs, WorkflowStateType ewst
            where   est.Project = prj.Oid and
                    ewfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState and
                    ewst.Oid = ewfs.WorkflowStateType and
                    ewst.Status not in (1, 7)
        ) and
        wst.Status not in (1, 7)
